method: Summon • Demon Parade • Wanted Quests • Dispatch

skills.name: Bottle Bash (妖酒壶/妖しの徳利)
skills.line: You'll be feeling this in the morning... Hic!
skills.description: Baketanuki strikes a single target over the head with his wine bottle, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK and inflicts 1 layer of Drunk on the target, lasts until the end of battle. Also has a 50% base chance of inflicting Provacation, lasts for 1 turn. ;Drunk (酒気) :'''General, Mark''': Max of 5 layers. Intoxicating fragrances from demonic wines. Can be ignited by Fiery Moonshine. :''(1-5 cups of Fiery Moonshine will circle around the enemy, 1 cup represents 1 layer.)''

skills.name: Drunken Stupor (醉倒/酔っぱらい)
skills.line: Booze! Booze! Bring... hic! Bring me some... Booze!
skills.description:
At the end of Baketanuki's turn, he has a 20% chance of becoming drunk until he wakes up on his next turn. When he wakes up, recovers his HP by 6% of his max HP
When Baketanuki is attacked while drunk, he has a 50% chance of inflicting 1 layer of Drunk on the attacker, lasts until the end of battle. ;Drunk (酒気) :'''General, Mark''': Max of 5 layers. Intoxicating fragrances from demonic wines. Can be ignited by Fiery Moonshine. :''(1-5 cups of Fiery Moonshine will circle around the enemy, 1 cup represents 1 layer.)''

upgrades.text: When woken up, increases move bar by 30%.
Chance of becoming drunk increases to 40%.
When woken up, inflicts 1 layer of Drunk on all enemies.

skills.name: Fiery Moonshine (烈焰之酒/炎の酒)
skills.line: There's a reason it's called firewater!
skills.description: Baketanuki swigs a mouthful of wine, restoring 18% of his max HP, and spews out flames that burn all enemies, dealing damage to all enemies equal to 12% of his current HP. ; : ;Drunk (酒気) :'''General, Mark''': Max of 5 layers. Intoxicating fragrances from demonic wines. Can be ignited by Fiery Moonshine. :''(1-5 cups of Fiery Moonshine will circle around the enemy, 1 cup represents 1 layer.)'' ;Firewater (酒火) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Each stack decreases DEF by 10% and deals indirect damage at the end of the target's turn.

bio.condition: Have Baketanuki gain 50000 Realm or Entrust EXP.
With Baketanuki win 40 times in PVN zones.
